cases.title: Complete over the artifact, key, replica and backup obligations of one target; acknowledgements arrive out of canonical order with an exact duplicate; replica and backup rejoin (not distributed).
A negative key acknowledgement gives PartialFailure; the retry closes it to Complete and a PreserveExact rule cannot restore the redacted claim.
A stale artifact acknowledgement and a missing replica acknowledgement leave the attempt PartialFailure at its deadline; a rejoin against it is refused.
The authority refuses authorization with PolicyConflict; the request is Rejected and a corrected ERQ1 bound to its ErasureCorrectionProvenanceV1 completes.

The pinned policy holds one artifact: its key, replica and backup obligations are Inapplicable, it keeps Exact with a retained-disclosure digest, and the request completes on the remaining obligations.
Every artifact class, transition rule and artifact state through ReplayClaimEvaluatorV1.
